title: Lockout laws repealed in the Sydney CBD (NSW)
summary: On 14 January 2020 the 1.30am lockout was removed in the Sydney CBD Entertainment Precinct (including Oxford Street), last drinks were extended by 30 minutes for venues with good records, and bottle-shop hours were extended statewide; Kings Cross restrictions were kept.
